PROBLEM (measured live): every gated reveal in a story is unlocked only when the player's command matches each authored word group in `action_evidence` as a whole word or phrase (storygame/runtime/candidate_matcher.py, `_matches_all`). Authors list verbs by hand, so natural phrasings fail. Example: the 1A reveal has groups [look, search, inspect, check] / [under, beneath, underside] / [drawer, KMS, workstation]. The player command 'Examine the underside of my initials-marked drawer.' fails only because 'examine' is not in group one. 'Look under my drawer.' passes. 'Feel under the drawer.' and 'Flip over the drawer.' fail. A reveal that never fires leaves the player stuck, and the small narrator model then invents filler instead. The module docstring says it deliberately infers no synonyms; that rule is being reversed now, on purpose, and you must update the docstring.

FIX (story-neutral; no story words, scene ids or entity names in the code): (1) Add a small fixed table of closed English synonym classes, applied to a group when ANY authored phrase in that group belongs to a class: then every member of that class is accepted for that group. Classes: LOOK = examine, inspect, search, look, check, study, investigate, explore, observe, scan, survey, probe, feel, rummage, 'look at', 'look through', 'look into', 'go through', 'rifle through', 'sift through'. READ = read, review, peruse, 'go over', study. TAKE = take, grab, 'pick up', retrieve, remove, pull, 'peel off', collect. UNDER = under, beneath, underneath, underside, below, 'bottom of', 'flip over', 'turn over', flip, lift, peel. OPEN = open, 'pry open', unlatch. TALK = talk, ask, question, speak, tell, interrogate, 'talk to', 'speak to', 'speak with'. A word may belong to only one class except that 'study' may sit in LOOK and READ. (2) Tolerate a plain singular/plural difference of one trailing 's' or 'es' on a single-word match (drawer matches drawers). Never apply it to words of 3 letters or fewer. (3) Keep everything else: negation words still reject the command; all groups are still required; uniqueness (exactly one candidate matches) is unchanged in `uniquely_matched_candidate` and `uniquely_matched_authored_handoff`. (4) Tests in tests/test_candidate_matcher.py: add cases for every class (an authored 'inspect' group accepts 'Examine'; an authored 'under' group accepts 'Flip over'), plural tolerance, a 3-letter word not pluralised, negation still rejecting, and that two candidates that now both match still return None. Keep every existing test passing; where an old test asserted that a synonym must NOT match, change it to assert the new behaviour and say so in notes.md. (5) Also add one regression test that loads the real story package at data/stories/continuity-initiative (look at tests/test_canon_journey.py or tests/test_markdown_story_package.py for how a test loads it) and checks that these commands each match the 1A reveal whose id is k_sl_1a_b_r0 and no other reveal when passed through `uniquely_matched_authored_handoff` against the candidates projected for scene 1A at its start: 'Examine the underside of my initials-marked drawer.', 'Feel under the drawer.', 'Flip over the KMS drawer.', 'Inspect beneath the workstation drawer.'. If building the projection is too heavy, instead call `_matches_all` directly with that reveal's action_evidence read from the package knowledge index. Run: TMPDIR=/tmp uv run pytest -q -x ; uv run ruff check --fix . ; uv run ruff format . . Write ./notes.md at the worktree root: what changed, tests changed and why.

PROBLEM (measured live): in scene 1A a model player who reads only the screen could not tell what to do. The authored gate cue exists for every gate fact in data/stories/continuity-initiative/handoffs.yaml (`cue_text`, example: Kristin's initials, KMS, are carved into a drawer of Michelle's workstation.), but (1) the engine stages a cue only once turns_since_entry >= the scene's nudge_after_turns (engine.py, the block that sets staged_cue_fact_id; 1A nudges at turn 10 of a 13 turn ceiling), and (2) when staged, cloudflare.py (variable `cue_rule`) only asks the small narrator model to 'Show this in the scene, as something Kristin notices', and the model paraphrases or drops it. The player is not told what is actionable, so scenes exit by the timed Deadline, not by play. Rule from the product owner: if the narration does not show the player what the scene needs, the game is broken.

FIX (story-neutral): (A) Stage the highest-ranked missing gate fact's cue from the player's FIRST turn in a scene instead of waiting for the nudge turn: replace the `turns_since_entry >= window.nudge_after_turns` condition for cue staging with an always-true one (keep the existing one-cue-per-turn, once-per-scene-visit, 'not delivered', 'in missing', 'has cue_text' and resolution-phase rules; keep handoff_after_turns Deadline staging exactly as it is). (B) Deliver the cue deterministically: do not rely on the narrator. When a cue is staged for the turn, append its cue_text verbatim as its own final narration segment of that turn's reply, the same way authored handoff delivery text is appended (read `_compose_authored_handoff` and how `delivery_text` segments are built and validated in cloudflare.py and reuse that path; the cue text must pass the same safety checks it passes today, see tests/test_cue_text_safety.py). Remove the narrator-facing `cue_rule` sentence so the cue is not said twice. Do not append a cue on a turn that is already an authored handoff turn or that changes the scene; in that case keep it staged for the next turn. Mark it delivered exactly as today (delivered_cue_ids) only after the turn succeeds, so a rejected turn does not consume it. (C) The opening: nothing to change. Tests: update every existing test that asserted the old timing or the old narrator cue_rule (for example 'no cue before the nudge turn' or 'No 1A prompt before the cue turn contains the KMS cue text') to assert the new behaviour: cue staged on turn 1, appended verbatim as the last narration segment, delivered once, kept for the next turn on a handoff or scene-change turn, not consumed by a rejected turn, and absent when the scene's gate facts are already true. List every test you changed and why in notes.md. Run: TMPDIR=/tmp uv run pytest -q -x ; uv run ruff check --fix . ; uv run ruff format . . Write ./notes.md at the worktree root.
